newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China EB Tech up on asset injection talk.
newsitem.headline: China EB Tech up on asset injection talk.

text.p: Shares of television and audio products maker China Everbright Technology Ltd rose on rumours of a possible asset injection, brokers said on Monday.
"Talk that its parent might inject China mobile phone projects into the company fueled the short term speculative demand," said a sales manager at a local brokerage.
China EB Tech shares rose HK$0.036 or 21.56 percent to a morning of HK$0.203 before they steadied at HK$0.196 at midday. Volume was 11.66 million shares worth HK$2.25 million.
The company officials were not available for comment.
